description: This file defines a debug view class for an internal caching component in Orleans, providing properties to inspect cache items and metrics for debugging purposes.

classes.name: CacheDebugView
classes.description: A debug view wrapper for inspecting the contents and metrics of a ConcurrentLruCache instance.

methods.name: CacheDebugView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the debug view with a specific cache instance.

methods.name: Items
methods.description: Returns an array of key-value pairs currently stored in the cache.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Property that exposes cache metrics for inspection.
